The Horde Army is the collective land-based military force of the various nations within the New Horde, safeguarding the modern faction's interests throughout Azeroth and beyond. Having taken part in numerous campaigns against the Alliance and other threats to the world, they are further supported in their operations by the Horde navy and the Horde air force. While the major part of the Horde's military power comes from its member states, several organizations exist within the Horde that do not belong to any of them, such as the Horde Expedition or the Vol'jin's Spear. Housing gives players a place to call home, providing permanent plots and a domicile that players can customize with decor collectable all over the universe. Housing exteriors may be customized based on racial styles, and the interiors are customizable with drag-and-place mechanics. Houses are organized into public or private "neighborhoods", where player characters can reside amongst random players or within a guild, respectively. The two neighborhoods are Founder's Point for the Alliance and Razorwind Shores for the Horde. These groups of homes are persistent, so that neighbors will remain neighbors until one of them intentionally moves. Plots are available for all independent of housing d

Hraxian was one of the oldest black dragons and Veritistrasz's idol. During a battle with the djaradin, Hraxian issued a challenge to protect his flight's medical wing and buy time for Neltharion to enact his plan. Hraxian killed scores of djaradin until, finally, he succumbed to the countless wounds they had inflicted and died on his feet, still staring them down even in death. It was the only time Veritistrasz saw the djaradin leave the body of a slain dragon untouched.

The Iron Rune are a group of iron dwarves that inhabit the Howling Fjord and Grizzly Hills, led by Iron Thane Argrum and Iron Thane Furyhammer. Thor Modan has been their besieged capital for thousands of years. They also have the city of Dun Argol, which has replaced Thor Modan as the capital of the iron dwarves, connected to Thor Modan by the Path of Iron.
